# Marketers & Advertisers Network (M·A·N)

> M·A·N is Ghana's peer-driven community for marketing and advertising professionals. It runs MAN Sessions (free community sessions, three a year) and the annual Digital Marketers’ Conference (DMC), held in Accra.

## Digital Marketers’ Conference 2026 — Built To Scale
- Date and time: Saturday 21 November 2026, 10:00–15:00 (GMT)
- Venue: British Council Accra, Liberia Road, Accra, Ghana
- Themes: Build Yourself, Build Your Team, Build Your Work
- Format: keynote, panel discussions, partner presentations and spotlights, a pitching masterclass and breakout sessions
- Capacity: about 200 attendees
- Tickets: sold through MojoPay (the official ticketing platform) at https://tickets.mojo-pay.com/events/digital-marketers-conference-2026. Early bird price GH₵100 until 31 October 2026; check that page for current pricing.
- Attendees can make a shareable personal flyer for the event at https://mangh.org/dmc-2026#flyer

### Confirmed speakers and hosts (programme still being finalised)
- Isaac Newton Acquah — Co-Founder, The Innovation Spark (presentation, Build Yourself)
- Alex Offei Lartey — Marketing Communications & Digital Solutions Consultant (panel)
- Ronald Tagoe — Founder & CEO, mNotify; Founder, Impact AI Labs (panel)
- Emelia Dede Quist — Employer Engagement Manager, Generation Ghana (panel)
- Kwaku Ofosuhene — Chief Commercial Officer, Mojo Payments (presentation, Build Your Team)
- Richard Sena Quashie, Simon Alangdee, Florentia Teye (panel, Build Your Team); Yvonne Dumor, Ian Hutchful (panel, Build Your Work)
- Enoch “RobotBoy” Appiah Jr. — host, COSM Podcast
- Samuel Kwabena Ansong — Marketing Manager, HR Certification Centre (pitching masterclass)
- The keynote speaker is yet to be announced.

### Sponsors and partners
- Title sponsor (Gold): MojoPay
- Silver sponsors: Generation Ghana and FIDO
- Partners: mNotify (programme partner), Kasad3 and Tech Labari (media partners), Koin Photography (event photography)
- Sponsorship tiers still open: Silver, Bronze and Cedar

## Pages
- [Home](https://mangh.org/): about M·A·N, team, partners, and how to join the community
- [DMC 2026](https://mangh.org/dmc-2026): programme, speakers, venue, travel guide, flyer maker and registration
- [MAN Sessions](https://mangh.org/sessions): community firesides and conference sessions
- [Partner with DMC 2026](https://mangh.org/partners): sponsorship tiers and enquiry form
- [Sponsor DMC 2026](https://mangh.org/sponsor): sponsorship enquiry form
- [Privacy and Terms](https://mangh.org/privacy): how sponsorship form data and website analytics are used, and the terms that apply
- [Press and media kit](https://mangh.org/press): fact sheet, boilerplate copy, speaker and sponsor lists, and photo downloads for journalists
- [DMC 2025 archive](https://mangh.org/dmc-2025): recap of the 2025 conference held at the Google AI Community Center, Accra on 28 November 2025, with speakers, partners and a photo gallery
